_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json or other fragments. ADR-031 external-integration imperative exception (ingress adapter).
_meta.description: Adds the ingress ledger schema TimeIntakeBatch (idempotency key = administrationId+batchId, records the batch → draft-invoice link) and extends the canonical UrenRegistratie schema with three provenance fields (externalId, sourceApp, sourceBatchId) so time entries materialised from an authenticated POST /apps/shillinq/api/billing/time-intake batch (pipelinq's time-billing-handoff-emit) are traceable back to their source. Deliberately does NOT declare a 'required' key on UrenRegistratie's merge fragment — the three provenance fields stay optional so pre-existing, manually-entered UrenRegistratie rows are unaffected (deep-merge concatenates 'required' arrays, so omitting the key here is load-bearing). Also seeds two CustomerMaster rows (cust-5432, cust-7788) beyond design.md's Seed Data section: the orchestrator's binding ruling requires organisationRef to resolve to a real shillinq customer/organisation record (422 otherwise), and no CustomerMaster seed data existed anywhere in the register prior to this change — without these two rows the seeded TimeIntakeBatch/UrenRegistratie demo objects would reference an organisationRef that can never resolve.

TimeIntakeBatch.title: Time Intake Batch
TimeIntakeBatch.description: Idempotency ledger for the billing-intake ingress adapter (ADR-031 external-integration exception). One row per accepted (administrationId, batchId) tuple; records what happened to the batch (received -> invoiced/failed), not a business-object lifecycle. Re-POSTing the same batchId with an identical payload short-circuits to the stored invoiceId (duplicated:true); a different payload under the same batchId is a 409 conflict, detected via payloadHash.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration this batch was ingested into (server-resolved from the session, never client-supplied — ADR-005).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

batchId.description: Idempotency key supplied by the caller. Unique per administration.
batchId.title: Batch ID

sourceApp.description: The Conduction app that emitted this batch.
sourceApp.title: Source App

organisationRef.description: The shillinq customer/organisation id (FK to CustomerMaster.customerId) this batch is billed against.
organisationRef.title: Organisation Ref

projectId.description: Optional FK to Project — the batch's projectRef, if supplied.
projectId.title: Project ID

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the batch (EUR only for this slice).
currency.title: Currency

periodStart.description: Start of the covered time-entry period.
periodStart.title: Period Start

periodEnd.description: End of the covered time-entry period.
periodEnd.title: Period End

entryCount.description: Number of time entries accepted from this batch (== BillableInvoiceLine rows on the resulting invoice).
entryCount.title: Entry Count

status.description: Ingress ledger state, not a business-object lifecycle (design.md). 'invoiced' once draftInvoice() has succeeded and this row is persisted.
status.title: Status

invoiceId.description: FK to the draft BillableInvoice materialised from this batch. Null until status=invoiced.
invoiceId.title: Invoice ID

receivedAt.description: Timestamp the batch was accepted by the intake endpoint.
receivedAt.title: Received At

payloadHash.description: sha256 of the normalised request payload (organisationRef, billingModel, currency, period, entries[]), computed at ingest time. Used to distinguish an identical replay (duplicated:true) from a batchId reused with a materially different payload (409 conflict, REQ per 'Idempotent intake by batch id').
payloadHash.title: Payload Hash

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Time Intake Batch is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

externalId.description: External id of this hour entry in the source app (e.g. pipelinq's time-entry id). Set only for entries materialised via the billing-intake endpoint; null for manually-entered hours.
externalId.title: External ID

sourceApp.description: The Conduction app that emitted this hour entry via the billing-intake endpoint. Null for manually-entered hours.
sourceApp.title: Source App

sourceBatchId.description: FK to the TimeIntakeBatch.batchId this hour entry was materialised from. Null for manually-entered hours.
sourceBatchId.title: Source Batch ID
